sources.entry: Manus *(Monica / closed)* — The original general-purpose cloud AI agent that sparked the open-source wave. Runs in a cloud Ubuntu sandbox with browser, shell, file system, and code execution. Built on Claude + Qwen under the hood. Crossed $100M ARR in 2026. Invite/subscription-based, not open-source, but listed for context.

summary.name: Manus
summary.one_liner: Manus is a cloud-based AI agent product that aims to execute tasks and automate workflows rather than only answer questions.
keywords: agent that does tasks for you
ai that builds websites and games
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Manus as an "action engine" that executes tasks rather than only giving answers. Its listed product areas include an AI design tool, AI slides, an AI image generator, an AI music generator, video creation, and "Wide Research." Quick-start prompts on the page include creating slides, building a website, and creating games. It lists a Slack integration, an API, and a Team plan with SSO. The page also lists a mobile app, a desktop app, and "My Browser" as download options. The page text itself gives few technical details about how the agent works.
notable: Positions itself as an action-oriented agent that executes tasks, not just a chatbot
Offers a Wide Research feature and integrations including Slack and an API
Listing notes it runs in a cloud Ubuntu sandbox, built on Claude and Qwen (from directory listing, not the page itself)
caveats: Closed source; the directory listing describes it as invite/subscription-based, which the page text does not state
Pricing details are not shown in the page text beyond a Pricing link; 'freemium' is inferred from the listing, not confirmed on the page
Platform names for desktop and mobile apps are not specified on the page
